tests.name: Output shape
tests.code:
import torch
out = {fn}(torch.randn(2, 8, 16), torch.randn(2, 8, 16), torch.randn(2, 8, 16), window_size=2)
assert out.shape == (2, 8, 16), f'Shape mismatch: {out.shape}'
